assistantMessage.text:
## Derived memo metadata

Memos carry content-derived metadata in two layers:

1. **Persisted** in `memo.payload` (`MemoPayload` in `proto/store/memo.proto`) — mainly `tags` and `property`.
2. **Computed at API read time** — `snippet` on the API `Memo` message (`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`), not stored in the DB payload.

`MemoPayload.location` is user-set via the API, not derived from markdown.

---

### Computation sites

| Layer | File | Function | Role |
|-------|------|----------|------|
| Core extraction | `internal/markdown/markdown.go` | `ExtractAll` (355–421), `ExtractProperties` (192–240), `ExtractTags` (142–169), `GenerateSnippet` (263–345) | Single goldmark AST walk; parses GFM + custom `#tag` / `@mention` extensions |
| Tag parsing | `internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`, `internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go` | `NewTagParser`, `TagExtension` | Turns `#tag` into AST nodes (skipped inside links/images) |
| Payload assembly | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | `RebuildMemoPayload` (74–87) | Calls `ExtractAll`, writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` |
| API response | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` | `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (76–80) | Sets `memoMessage.Snippet` via `getMemoContentSnippet` |
| Snippet helper | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` | `getMemoContentSnippet` (83–89) | `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` |

`ExtractAll` is the main path used by `RebuildMemoPayload`:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

---

### Properties extracted

**Stored in `MemoPayload` (from content):**

| Field | Source logic (`ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties`) |
|-------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `tags[]` | `#tag` nodes via custom tag parser; deduped, case preserved; ignored inside links/images |
| `property.has_link` | Any `KindLink` node |
| `property.has_code` | Code block, fenced code block, or inline code span |
| `property.has_task_list` | GFM task checkbox node |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` | Unchecked task checkbox |
| `property.title` | Plain text of first block-level child if it is an H1 |

Schema: `proto/store/memo.proto` lines 14–22; extraction: `internal/markdown/markdown.go` lines 383–408.

**API-only (not in DB payload):**

| Field | Computation |
|-------|-------------|
| `snippet` | Plain-text summary, max 64 chars, word-truncated (`GenerateSnippet`) |

**Extracted but not persisted in payload:** `ExtractAll` also collects `Mentions` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go` 379–381), used only for mention notifications in `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (`resolveMentionTargets`), not written by `RebuildMemoPayload`.

---

### Recomputation triggers

**Persisted payload (`tags` + `property`):**

1. **`CreateMemo`** — always before insert (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` 108). Includes comments via `CreateMemoComment` → `CreateMemo` (`memo_service_comments.go` 56–59).
2. **`UpdateMemo`** — only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` (`memo_service.go` 436–451). Other fields (visibility, pinned, location, etc.) do not recompute derived metadata.
3. **Batch maintenance** — `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` 26–72) rebuilds all memos in batches; not wired into normal server startup in this repo (no callers of `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` outside the runner package).

**Snippet:** recomputed on every API conversion (list/get/relations/notifications), not tied to a write event — e.g. `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` and `batchConvertMemoRelations` in `memo_service_converter.go`.

---

### Use in lists / previews / filtering

- **Lists/previews:** `snippet` in `MemoCommentListView`, `MemoSnippetLink`, `UserMemoMap`, relation sidebars; `tags` in `MemoView` / `MemoDetailSidebar`.
- **Filtering:** `property.has_link`, `property.has_task_list`, `property.has_code` → CEL filters (`web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts` 73–78); backed by JSON paths in `internal/filter/schema.go` 173–228 (`memo.payload` → `tags`, `property.hasLink`, etc.).
- **Stats:** `user_service_stats.go` aggregates tags and property flags from stored payload.

**Not user-set:** `tags`, all `property.*` fields, and `snippet` are `OUTPUT_ONLY` in the API proto (`memo_service.proto` 240–266). `location` is the main payload field users set directly.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` calls `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`; on memo creation, content updates, and batch payload rebuilds (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`); extracts deduplicated `#tags`, first-H1 title, and link/code/task-list/incomplete-task flags from Markdown (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`).
